---
title: A footnote in a tabset inside a callout
format: html
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      noErrors: true
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - [
            'div.callout div.tab-pane a.footnote-ref[href="#fn1"]',
            'section#footnotes div#fn2',
          ]
        - ['span.quarto-note-reference']
---

Regression fixture for bd-akkproqy: a tabset nested in a callout is a
custom node inside a custom node when the footnote transforms run, so their
walkers must recurse through both. q2-preview has no tabset component yet
(bd-47afd5ro), so this fixture's DOM checks run on native render only.

::: {.callout-note}
::: {.panel-tabset}
## Tab

In a tab.[^c]
:::
:::

After the callout.[^a]

[^c]: Note C.
[^a]: Note A.
